current_status.from: Active as of 2026-09-23. Sierra County Commissioners unanimously amended and adopted Resolution No. 2026-51 at their July 21, 2026 meeting, imposing an 18-month moratorium on new data centers in the county (through approximately 2028-01-21). As of September 3, 2026, New Mexico Commissioner of Public Lands Stephanie Garcia Richard publicly stated the moratorium also applies to the Spaceport America property (on state trust land) and that she would not approve a proposed Aetherion/Green Data sublease there while it remains in force, and Sierra County Commissioner Sandy Jones told the Albuquerque Journal (reporting published in early September 2026) he would not support efforts to amend or narrow the moratorium despite a developer's lobbying. No rescission, amendment, or replacement was found in sources reviewed through 2026-09-23.
